summary.zh: 规划招聘、薪酬带宽与组织架构
summary.en: Plan hiring, comp bands, org design, performance, and retention.

description.zh: 回答该招谁、开多少薪、团队怎么划分，以及员工为什么离开。适合制定年度招聘计划、设计薪酬带宽或调整组织结构时使用。
description.en: Answers who to hire, what to pay, how to structure teams, and why people leave. Use it to build a hiring plan, set compensation bands, or reshape the org structure and performance process.
